record.name: T-MINUS
record.summary: Single-page event countdown experience with animated cards, category filters and browser-local voting/follow interactions.
record.contribution: Roy independently built T-MINUS, as explicitly confirmed by Roy on 2026-10-19.
results: Source contains event countdown rendering and localStorage-backed interaction state; no active community or multi-user backend is established.
limitations: Archived repository; current hosted availability was not independently tested.
Browser-local vote state does not demonstrate real shared community votes, users or retention.
Project dates, reused assets and current project maturity still require confirmation.

discovery.reason: Include an archived interactive web prototype, while correcting the distinction between local browser voting and an actual shared community service.
discovery.notes: Source inspected by Codex Work; project code/tests were not executed in this review. Personal/team attribution remains pending.
